ZestSSH credits and trademarks

Names and logos of others

The operating system, distribution and product names and logos the app shows beside a host (Ubuntu, Debian,
macOS, Windows, Proxmox VE, Raspberry Pi, Arch Linux, Alpine Linux, FreeBSD, NixOS, Home Assistant, Fedora,
Linux Mint, Pop!_OS, Kali Linux, TrueNAS, Unraid, VMware ESXi, openSUSE, CentOS, and a generic container mark) are
trademarks or registered trademarks of their owners. The app draws simplified pictures of them
(lib/core/data/os_logos.dart) only to show which system a host runs. They are not covered by the app's licence,
and their use implies no endorsement by, or connection with, their owners.

The names of the fonts (Cascadia Code, Fira Code, Geist, Hack, JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, Symbols Nerd Font)
and of the colour schemes below are their owners' as well; each font's licence is given under its own name.

"ZestSSH", "Zest" and the ZestSSH logo are trademarks of Affluent Labs LLC.

Colour schemes

Several of the app's themes and terminal colour schemes take their colours from a published colour scheme, and
carry its name. With thanks to their authors:

| Theme                                  | Colour scheme by             | Where                                             | Licence        |
|----------------------------------------|------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|----------------|
| Catppuccin Mocha                       | the Catppuccin project       | https://github.com/catppuccin/catppuccin          | MIT            |
| Dracula                                | the Dracula Theme project    | https://github.com/dracula/dracula-theme          | MIT            |
| Gruvbox Dark                           | morhetz                      | https://github.com/morhetz/gruvbox                | MIT            |
| Nord                                   | the Nord project             | https://github.com/nordtheme/nord                 | MIT            |
| One Dark, One Light                    | the Atom editor's One themes | https://github.com/atom/one-dark-syntax           | MIT            |
| Solarized Dark                         | Ethan Schoonover             | https://github.com/altercation/solarized          | MIT            |
| Tokyo Night                            | enkia                        | https://github.com/enkia/tokyo-night-vscode-theme | MIT            |
| Monokai Pro                            | Monokai                      | https://monokai.pro                               | the name only  |
| Darcula, IntelliJ Dark, IntelliJ Light | JetBrains' IDE themes        | https://www.jetbrains.com                         | the names only |

The app's own themes (Ember, Daylight, Graphite, Midnight, AMOLED Black and the other terminal schemes) are
Affluent Labs' own.
